system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes in dressing-gown, springing up from the bed beside Watson in the dim bedroom","action":"Holmes strikes a match and lashes furiously with his cane at the bell-pull, while Watson sits tense and alert nearby","setting":"Stoke Moran bedroom at deep night, oak-panelled walls, a ventilator high above the wall, a dark-lantern glimmer from the adjoining room","secondaryElements":"Thin wisp of steam-like hiss near the ventilator, faint smoke and gleam of heated metal, the bell-pull swinging, a plain bed with a dim lamp on the table","mood":"Tense, gothic, suspenseful, with dry restraint and gaslit intimacy","timeOfDay":"Past three in the small hours, deep night","composition":"Medium shot from the bedside, Holmes mid-motion in the foreground with the match flare lighting his face, Watson seated behind, ventilator and bell-pull in the upper frame"}
